jobs.title: Fast Stream Growth Marketing Programme (all genders)
jobs.address: Berlin, Tauentzienstraße, City West, Charlottenburg, Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf, Berlin, 10789, Deutschland
jobs.description:
Fast Stream Growth Marketing Programme

About the role: What's in the Box

As AI is rapidly changing the the growth marketing landscape, HelloFresh is opening an exclusive rotational program, hiring highly talented and high potential individuals, and growing them into AI-native growth marketing professionals. Over 18 months, you will complete three rotations: owning and running a live paid channel and also being involved in wider strategic marketing topics: In this role, you will have autonomy and budget ownership; take on work with visible commercial impact, and help shape the AI-enabled ways of working, that the wider marketing organisation will adopt. 

You will be based in Berlin, but will also have the opportunity to gain experience from our team in New York City, on short-term assignments. 

What you'll do: The Recipe

  • Deliver priority projects: Take on scoped projects for host teams, such as a Performance marketing blueprint definition, a GEO pilot or an incrementality measurement project, from problem definition through design and to roll-out.
  • Run a live channel: Own campaigns, channel budgets and performance during your performance-management rotation, and make decisions that move the numbers and impact the P&L.
  • Apply and expand the AI growth playbook: Use AI to draft, analyse and automate real marketing work, and progress from everyday tools to custom agents, automated workflows and AI-powered dashboards.
  • Build a wide network: Work across Global Marketing and its partner teams, learn from expert teams, and build relationships with mentors and leaders across the business.
  • Contribute to group priorities: Support top-priority strategic projects at group level and share what you learn with host teams and the wider marketing organisation.

What you'll bring: The Ingredients

  • Professional experience: Experience in a fast-paced environment, with a track record of owning work from problem definition through to delivery.
  • Graduate qualification: An MBA or Master's degree in business, engineering or data from top tier school. 
  • Working AI fluency: Confident use of AI tools to draft, summarise and analyse, and the motivation to build custom agents, automated workflows and AI-powered dashboards.
  • Initiative and fast learning: An entrepreneurial mindset, a willingness to take initiative, and the adaptability to learn quickly as technology and ways of working change. You take ownership early and are comfortable challenging the status quo.
  • Structured problem-solving: The ability to break down complex, ambiguous problems and execute against a clear plan.
  • Analytical rigour: Comfort with data and numbers, and experience in turning analysis into decisions.
  • Stakeholder communication: Clear communication and a track record of influencing senior stakeholders, with a genuine interest in marketing and top-line strategy.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't “tick all the boxes” but think you'd thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

  • You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
  • Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
  • Save with discount schemes and corporate benefits via Vorteile.net

Health & Wellbeing

  • Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
  • Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.

Flexibility & Work-Life

  • Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
  • Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.
  • Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Career & Development

  • Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

Culture & Environment

  • Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.
  • We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

jobs.title: Associate Product Designer - Wealth building and Lending
jobs.address: Barcelona, 67, Müllerstraße, Afrikanisches Viertel, Wedding, Mitte, Berlin, 13349, Deutschland
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Wealth is where customers grow their money with N26. It spans the full journey: saving day to day, putting idle cash to work in flexible cash funds, investing in stocks, ETFs and crypto, and understanding how it all adds up. That means the experience around savings, flexible cash funds, asset discovery, orders, and portfolio, and the connections between them. Customers increasingly move between these spaces, and our job is to make that feel like one clear, trustworthy experience. Assets under custody have more than doubled in the last year, and the number of products and initiatives in Wealth keeps growing.

You'll work across the domain rather than on a single product area. Depending on what the team needs, that could mean designing how customers discover and understand flexible cash funds, refining the order flow and order history, helping customers read and act on their portfolio, bringing clarity to asset discovery and asset detail pages, or designing the interaction patterns and data visualisations (like performance charts) that make complex financial information easy to grasp. You'll work on self-contained initiatives of low to mid complexity, with guidance from your paired designer, and your scope will grow as you do.

You'll be designing for a regulated financial product used by millions, where trust, clarity, and detail matter. The bar is high, and the work matters.

In your next challenge, you will:

  • Design well-scoped features and improvements across Wealth, from understanding the problem through exploration to shipped work.
  • Design intuitive interactions and polished interfaces, with careful attention to edge cases and error states.
  • Help customers understand products like flexible cash funds, where clear explanation and the right moment to surface them make the difference.
  • Use and contribute to our design system, Pulse, keeping your work consistent with the patterns the team relies on.
  • Plan and run simple usability tests and interviews, and turn what you learn into clear, actionable insights.
  • Use data to understand how customers behave and to check whether your work is making a difference.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, research, and data to ship work that lands, and learn from it once it's live.
  • Explain the "why" behind your decisions to your team, and seek feedback early and often.
  • Use AI tools as part of your design practice, for exploration, prototyping, and synthesis.
  • Share what you learn with your peers and suggest improvements to how the team works.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • You're fluent in Figma, and you keep getting better at it. You build with Auto Layout by default, so designs behave properly across screen sizes, languages and dynamic content. You work with components, variants and variables, and you move quickly with commands and shortcuts instead of reaching for the mouse. A tidy, well-named file is part of your craft. You're not satisfied with "good enough" in the tool and enjoy learning new features and techniques, then sharing them with the team.
  • You're curious about the problem before the solution. You ask who the user is, what they need, and what constraints you're working within.
  • You like to ship. You prototype to learn, share work early, and prefer real feedback over polishing in isolation.
  • You're curious about money, saving and investing, or willing to become so. You don't need to be an expert, but you want to make complex financial topics easy for everyone to understand.
  • You use AI to work better, not to skip the thinking. You're curious about how AI is changing design and product, and you use it to explore options, prototype and synthesise research faster. You also know it doesn't replace good craft or judgement. You can tell when an output is generic, inaccurate or wrong for a regulated financial product, and you take responsibility for the final result.
  • You think beyond the single screen. You see how savings, funds, orders, and portfolio connect, and you design with the wider journey in mind.
  • You're a generous collaborator. You give and receive feedback well, and you want to make the work better, not just your part of it.
  • You're organised and reliable. You manage your own tasks, meet timelines, and speak up early when something is at risk.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
  • Come together with your team in the office for a dedicated day of teamwork each week, plus another day of your choice, and enjoy the flexibility of remote work the rest of the time. Some roles may require additional in-office presence.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.    
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses. 
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

jobs.description: About Us 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries. Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity. About the Team We are looking for a motivated Software Engineer to join our Accounting team, which builds and operates the data flows between our billing, payments, and BSS platforms and our ERP (NetSuite). You will help develop, test, and run integrations that keep financial data accurate, traceable, and on time, working alongside experienced engineers who will support your growth. You will work closely with Finance, Billing, Payments, and Product teams, learning how telecom billing and accounting processes fit together and turning business needs into reliable software. You will be part of an international environment where engineering ownership, customer focus, accountability, and collaboration are expected. This is a hybrid role, based in Berlin or Lisbon. Fluency in English is essential for this role. About the Role Develop, test, and maintain backend services and integrations that move financial data between our internal systems and our ERP (NetSuite). Translate requirements from Finance and product stakeholders into well-scoped development tasks, with guidance from senior team members. Build and maintain REST APIs and event-driven integrations between billing, payments, and accounting systems. Help ensure accuracy, consistency, and traceability of financial data, including reconciliation and exception handling. Write clean, well-tested code and take part in code reviews, learning and applying the team's coding standards. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployments in AWS and Kubernetes. Monitor services in production using metrics, logs, and dashboards, and help investigate and fix incidents. Write and maintain technical documentation for the team's data flows and integrations. Build, monitor, and maintain integrations using Celigo (our iPaaS) to ensure reliable data flow between systems. Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity and quality. Grow your knowledge of accounting and ERP concepts, and share what you learn with the team. Requirements About You Must Have Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or 1+ years of professional software development experience. Solid programming skills in at least one modern backend language (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript). Or similar. Understanding of REST API design and integration between systems. Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and automated testing. Strong attention to detail and care for data accuracy. Genuine interest in financial systems and motivation to learn ERP and accounting concepts such as invoicing, revenue recognition, and reconciliation. Good communication skills and willingness to ask questions, learn, and collaborate. Ability to use AI coding assistants and agents (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar) throughout the software lifecycle: designing, writing, reviewing, testing, debugging and documenting code Fluent written and spoken English. Nice to Have Exposure to billing, payments, or finance domains. Experience with bank and payment reconciliation. Familiarity with accounting or ERP software such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, or Microsoft Dynamics. Experience integrating with banking APIs or financial data providers, such as Plaid, or Open Banking APIs. Experience with NetSuite (SuiteScript 2.x including map/reduce, RESTlet and scheduled scripts, SuiteTalk web services, saved searches) or another ERP. Experience with PostgreSQL. Experience with event-driven systems such as Kafka. Familiarity with automation and integration tools such as n8n, Celigo, or Workato. Experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki. Experience in Telecom. Benefits Why 1GLOBAL? Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs. Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry. Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals. Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field. International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company. Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment. Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally. jobs.title: Managing Partner (m/w/d) für den Mittelstand: unternehmerische Alternative zur nächsten Position
jobs.description: Machen Sie den nächsten Schritt und werden Sie Partner in einem bewährten KMU Berater-Netzwerk zusammen. Wenn eine Führungsposition nach vielen Jahren endet führt der übliche Weg in die nächste Bewerbung. Es gibt einen zweiten Weg, den erfahrene Führungskräfte häufig erst spät in Betracht ziehen: die eigene Beratungsgesellschaft, in der Ihre Erfahrung der Kern des Angebots ist und nicht eine Zeile im Lebenslauf. In unserem Partnersystem gehen Sie diesen Schritt mit einem ausgearbeiteten Angebot, einer erprobten Methodik, einer Einarbeitung, die vor dem ersten Mandat stattfindet und mit Unterstützung bei der Mandantengewinnung. thexton armstrong lädt leitende Führungskräfte und erfahrene Unternehmer ein sich als Geschäftsführer / selbstständiger Partner bei thexton armstrong zu bewerben. Ihre Aufgabe Sie begleiten Geschäftsinhaber mittelständischer Unternehmen in Ihrem Lizenzgebiet dabei, Ertrag, Organisation und Unternehmenswert zu verbessern. Sie arbeiten mit den Analysewerkzeugen und Beratungsprogrammen des Netzwerks und rechnen Ihre Mandate über monatliche Honorare ab. Sie bauen Schritt für Schritt einen eigenen Mandantenstamm in Ihrer Region auf. Was Sie mitbringen Langjährige Führungs- und Ergebnisverantwortung in einem oder mehreren Unternehmensbereichen Die Fähigkeit, das Vertrauen von Inhabern zu gewinnen, und die Bereitschaft, selbst auf Unternehmen zuzugehen Den Willen, unternehmerisch zu arbeiten, einschließlich des Risikos, das damit verbunden ist Die finanzielle Grundlage, um den Einstieg und eine Anlaufphase zu tragen Was Sie erwarten können Eine Tätigkeit, in der Berufs- und Lebenserfahrung ein Vorteil sind, weil Inhaber einen Gesprächspartner mit eigener Führungspraxis suchen Einen Beginn, der sich auf Ihre Lage abstimmen lässt, zum Beispiel auf eine Kündigungsfrist, eine Freistellung oder eine laufende Outplacement-Beratung Ein eigenes Unternehmen mit eigenem Lizenzgebiet, das Sie nach Ihren Vorstellungen ausbauen Geringe operative Kosten - Sie haben die kontrolle über den Overhead Einen Kreis von Partnern mit vergleichbarem Werdegang und eine laufende fachliche Begleitung Über uns thexton armstrong ist ein internationales Beratungsnetzwerk, das sich auf Unternehmens-Mentoring und Wachstumsberatung für KMU spezialisiert hat . Seit 2012 haben wir Tausenden von Geschäftsinhabern geholfen, Rentabilität, Resilienz und langfristigen Wertzuwachs durch ein strukturiertes Business-Mentoring-Framework zu stärken, das praktische Erfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen verbindet. Wir sind derzeit erfolgreich in den Niederlanden, Belgien und dem Vereinigten Königreich tätig und expandieren nun in Nord- und Ostdeutschland sowie bald auch in Westdeutschland . Ihre Chance Dies ist eine seltene Gelegenheit als Partner Ihr eigenes Beratungsunternehmen in einem Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Kollegen aufzubauen und zu führen, während Sie Teil eines etablierten und bewährten Systems sind. Als Geschäftsführer erwerben Sie die exklusiven Rechte für ein Gebiet in Nord- und Ostdeutschland und spielen eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Expansion unserer Marke sowie der Unterstützung von KMU-Unternehmen und deren Eigentümern in Ihrer Region. Der Rahmen Sie arbeiten als selbständiger Unternehmer mit eigener Gesellschaft. Der Einstieg ist mit einer einmaligen Investition und laufenden Lizenzgebühren verbunden. Die Zahlen und die Vertragsgrundlagen legen wir Ihnen im Erstgespräch vollständig offen. Die Gewinnung von Mandanten liegt in Ihrer Verantwortung. In der Anlaufphase unterstützen wir Sie aber bei den ersten Kontakten zu Geschäftsinhabern; die Einnahmen bauen sich in dieser Zeit erst auf. Umsatz und Einkommen gestalten Sie selbst, weil das Ergebnis von Ihrer Arbeit und Ihrem Gebiet abhängt. Der nächste Schritt Am Anfang steht ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch (online, 30 bis 45 Minuten). Data Analyst - Investments

Summary

We are seeking an organised and self-motivated Data Analyst to work embedded in our Investments team, to help shape the development of one of the world's leading FinTech products. 

About the opportunity

As a Data Analyst, you will enable our product and business segments in the Financial Empowerment domain, specifically Investments, to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams' initiatives, helping to drive the strategy of your business segment. You will apply robust analytical approaches, including experimentation and causal inference methods where appropriate, to understand the impact of product and business decisions on customer and business outcomes. You are here to establish a data mindset and thereby foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross-functional setup, collaborating closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In this role, you will:

  • Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities. 

  • Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions. 

  • Evaluate initiatives: Support product experimentation and impact measurement initiatives; design experiments and causal inference analyses, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analyses, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise, empathic communication.

  • Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves. 

  • Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs. 

  • Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.

  • Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.

  • Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to): 

    • Support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points and business opportunities.

    • Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods.

    • Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses.

    • During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service.

    • Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team.

What you need to be successful:

Background: 

  • 3+ years of experience, ideally within the Product or Analytics field. 

  • 1+ years of experience in the Investments or Wealth domain

Skills:

  • Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data (e.g. causal inference)

  • Strong problem solving skills and is comfortable doing exploratory data analysis that generates insights and “so whats”

  • Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics

  • Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc)

  • Good presentation skills and communication skills.

  • Experience with Experimentation (e.g. AB testing, multivariate etc)

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most innovative banks 🚀.

  • Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

jobs.title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine leveraging AI and data to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. We are looking for a Staff Data Platform Engineer to join our Data Platform team. Our team builds and operates the shared foundation that powers analytics, machine learning, business intelligence and AI-driven experiences across the entire company. As a senior individual contributor, you will shape how we move, store, govern, and serve data at scale, enabling every downstream team to build faster and with greater confidence. If you enjoy turning ambiguity into clear technical direction and durable solutions, we’d love to hear from you. This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Design and evolve the architecture of KAYAK’s shared Data Platform, including near-real-time streaming, lakehouse storage, schema management, semantic layer, and distributed query infrastructure. Make thoughtful trade-offs between latency, correctness, cost, and long-term maintainability. Deliver high-impact platform initiatives end-to-end — from problem framing and architecture design through implementation, rollout, and operational handoff. Define and promote technical standards for data contracts, schema evolution, ingestion patterns, and production readiness across platform and domain teams. Lead high-impact platform initiatives from problem framing and architecture design through implementation, rollout, and operational handoff. Develop reusable patterns and reference architectures for streaming ingestion, compaction, retention, schema governance, observability, and other recurring data engineering challenges. Establish reliable observability across the platform, including pipeline monitoring, consumer lag tracking, data quality checks, and alerting. Collaborate closely with Operations, Security, Engineering, Data Engineering, and Data Science, and Analytics to evolve the platform, build cross-functional support, and ensure the platform meets the needs of its users. Drive the semantic layer and metadata strategy that supports consistent and trusted self-service analytics and AI-driven data access. Evaluate technologies and approaches across streaming, storage, query, orchestration, and cloud infrastructure, balancing scalability, operational complexity, cost, and maintainability. Coach and mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and reusable technical guidance. jobs.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Kurz und knapp Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Falkensee bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas. Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen. Das erwartet dich Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers. Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht. Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche). Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level. Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand. Das bringst du mit Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium). Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit. Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus. Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln. Darauf kannst du dich freuen Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt. Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert. Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr. Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung. Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch. Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam. Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an. Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden! Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern. Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Serviceassistenz (m/w/d) | BritCars | Berlin/ Spandau bei Autohaus Dinnebier GmbH | softgarden View job here Serviceassistenz (m/w/d) | BritCars | Berlin/ Spandau Vollzeit Brunsbütteler Damm 192-194, 13581 Berlin Mit Berufserfahrung 21.09.26 Die Unternehmensgruppe Dinnebier sucht zur Festanstellung: Serviceassistentz (m/w/d) BritCars in Berlin / Spandau Unsere Mission: Wir schaffen täglich positive Erlebnisse – mit Service, der nicht nur funktioniert, sondern begeistert. Als erste Anlaufstelle für Kund innen, Kolleg innen und Partner bist du im Service die Visitenkarte unseres Unternehmens. Wir glauben daran, dass echter Service mehr ist als Abläufe und Prozesse: Es geht um Menschen, um Aufmerksamkeit und um das gute Gefühl, bestens betreut zu sein. Deine Mission bei uns: Du bist Organisationstalent, Möglichmacher in und Stimmungsträger in in einem. Du denkst mit, handelst proaktiv und behältst auch in stressigen Momenten den Überblick. jobs.description: About Us 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries. Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity. About the Team We seek an experienced and pragmatic Regulatory Counsel to join our in-house legal team in Amsterdam, Berlin, or Lisbon to support the business on a broad range of telecommunications and digital regulatory matters across the EU and other key international markets. This is a temporary, fixed-term position to cover a period of maternity leave, for an expected duration of approximately 9 months starting in January 2027. The successful candidate will ensure continuity of regulatory support to the business during this period, with the possibility of an ongoing role at the expiry of the period covered. This role will suit a lawyer with strong experience in telecoms regulation, platform regulation and digital compliance, who is ready to work in a fast-paced, international tech environment. The emphasis of this role is advising 1GLOBAL on the law that is specific to the telecommunications industry with equal focus across all 1GLOBAL countries. You should have a sound knowledge of the European Electronic Communications Code. This is a 9-month maternity cover role with the potential to extend, subject to individual performance and business needs. About the Role Advise internal stakeholders on regulatory and compliance obligations across all countries in which 1GLOBAL operates concerning the telecoms and digital space, including areas such as: Electronic communications services (EECC and national implementation); Platform regulation (e.g. DSA, DMA); Content regulation (e.g. illegal and harmful content, CSAM rules); Cybersecurity (e.g. NIS2); Data privacy (GDPR); Roaming, MVNO licensing, spectrum allocation; Consumer protection. Nice to Have In-house experience; Experience working for or engaging directly with a telecommunications regulatory authority; IP law experience or litigation experience; A keen interest in technology. jobs.description: About Us 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries. Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity. About the Team The Enterprise team owns 1GLOBAL's products for businesses: global mobile connectivity for multinational enterprises, delivered through one platform, one contract and one invoice. Our customers manage their entire mobile estate in the Enterprise Portal, from subscriptions, usage and invoices to orders such as SIM swaps and suspensions, spend alerts, user roles and single sign-on. We recently retired two legacy portals and moved every enterprise customer onto our new Enterprise Portal. That has created strong demand and a steady flow of requests from customers and internal teams, with a lot of exciting work ahead. We work closely with engineering, design, customer support, customer success, account management, operations and commercial teams. We are looking for a Product Manager to shape the next chapter of the Enterprise Portal: what we show, how we show it, which reports and analytics we offer, and which actions customers can take themselves. This is a UI and UX-heavy role, where design judgement matters as much as sharp prioritisation. About the Role You will lead discovery and delivery for the Enterprise Portal, turning a high volume of customer and internal requests into a clear roadmap and a portal that enterprise customers enjoy using. Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for the Enterprise Portal, deciding which dashboards, reports, analytics and self-service capabilities come next. Run customer and UX research: talk to portal users directly and gather the voice of the customer from support, customer success, account management and operations. Work hands-on with design from first concept to final UI, shaping flows, wireframes and prototypes and holding a high bar for UX and UI quality. Shape the portal's integrations with mobile device management (MDM) platforms such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune, so enterprise IT teams can manage devices and connectivity together. Prioritise work of every size, from small fixes and quick improvements to large multi-quarter projects, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly to every stakeholder. Use analytics and data to understand how customers use the portal, spot friction and measure the impact of what we ship. Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria with engineering, understanding the APIs behind the portal well enough to shape what is feasible. Requirements About You Must Have 4+ years in product management, including ownership of a B2B portal, dashboard or web application used by business customers. Hands-on experience with customer and UX research: interviews and turning feedback from many channels into clear problems worth solving. Experience with event-based product analytics such as Amplitude or similar products: defining events, building charts and funnels, and using the data to make decisions. Strong prioritisation across a constant flow of requests, with the judgement to say no and the ability to explain why. Proven collaboration across many departments, from engineering and design to customer success, account management, operations and sales, in fluent written and spoken English. A working understanding of APIs and how a portal reads and writes data through them. This is not a technical role, but API fluency will help you shape what is feasible with engineers. Nice to Have Telecom experience, for example enterprise mobile services, MVNO platforms or eSIM. Hands-on Amplitude experience, including tracking plans, event taxonomy and dashboards. Experience with design systems, or with data visualisation for business users. Benefits Why 1GLOBAL? Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs. Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry. Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals. Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field. International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company. Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment. Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally. jobs.description: Head of Sales B2B (m/w/d) Head of Sales B2B (m/w/d) Berlin, Hamburg Berlin, Hamburg Head of Sales B2B (m/w/d) Jetzt bewerben Als zentraler Dienstleister für Sparkassen stehen wir für Qualität, Innovation und Verlässlichkeit. Mit rund 1.400 Mitarbeitenden in ganz Deutschland sorgen wir täglich dafür, dass Prozesse und digitale Lösungen in der Marktfolge effizient laufen. So können sich Sparkassen auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren: ihre Kundinnen und Kunden. Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebs suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Strukturen weiterentwickelt und gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen nachhaltige Geschäftserfolge erzielt. Ihre neuen Aufgaben Sie übernehmen die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Vertriebsteams und entwickeln die Organisation im Rahmen eines weiteren Ausbaus konsequent weiter Dabei verantworten Sie die Erreichung vertrieblicher Ziele sowie die nachhaltige Sicherung und Entwicklung des Bestands- und Neugeschäfts Die Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozess obliegt Ihnen – von der Geschäftsanbahnung über Angebot, Verhandlung und Vertragsabschluss bis zur geordneten Übergabe und weiteren Kundenentwicklung Sie bauen belastbare Beziehungen zu Vorständen, Geschäftsführungen und weiteren Entscheidungsträgern auf und führen auch anspruchsvolle Verhandlungen souverän zum Abschluss Zudem gestalten Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Vertragsmanagement und Kundenservice aktiv und entwickeln vertriebliche Standards kontinuierlich weiter Ihre Führung basiert auf Basis klarer Kennzahlen. Pipeline, Forecast, Abschluss- und Wiederbeauftragungsquoten sind für Sie zentrale Steuerungsinstrumente, das CRM Ihre operative Grundlage Ihre Stärken zählen Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung von Vertriebsteams sowie im Aufbau oder der erfolgreichen Neuausrichtung von Vertriebsorganisationen Nachweisbare Erfolge im B2B-Lösungsvertrieb komplexer Dienstleistungen Erfahrung in Geschäftsmodellen, die auf regelmäßiger Wiederbeauftragung, Vertragsverlängerung oder kontinuierlicher Kundenentwicklung basieren Ausgeprägte Verhandlungsstärke, diplomatisches Geschick und hohe Abschlussorientierung auf Top-Management-Ebene Fähigkeit, bereichsübergreifend zu führen, Interessen zu bündeln und Organisationen erfolgreich durch Veränderungsprozesse zu begleiten Erfahrung in der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe ist willkommen, jedoch keine Voraussetzung Reisebereitschaft sowie Präsenz an einem unserer Standorte in Hamburg oder Berlin Unsere Benefits Gehalt: Wir zahlen fair und transparent dank unserer starken Betriebsvereinbarung. Die Vergütung dieser Position richtet sich nach Ihren Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen. Work-Life-Balance: Mit einer Rahmenarbeitszeit von 6 – 20 Uhr ohne Kernzeiten und individuellen Regelungen zum mobilen Arbeiten bieten wir Ihnen die Flexibilität, die Sie brauchen. Mobilität: Unkomplizierte Arbeitswege – mit unserem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, attraktivem Fahrradleasing und allseits bequemer Anbindung. Perspektive: Ein anspruchsvolles und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum – wir wachsen gemeinsam. Gesundheit: Mit unserem betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement sorgen wir aktiv für Ihr Wohlbefinden. Und das fängt bereits bei höhenverstellbaren Tischen an. Gemeinschaft: Unser Erfolg beruht auf starken Teams, die verlässlich und vertrauensvoll zusammenarbeiten. Unser kollegiales Miteinander zeigt sich im Workshop ebenso wie auf dem Betriebsfest. Unsere Benefits sind so vielfältig wie Ihre Karrierewege bei uns. HIER finden Sie alle Angebote. Lust bekommen? Dann direkt über unser kurzes Online-Formular bewerben! Doch noch offene Fragen?
